title: ErrorStructure
description: SAIA-Class S universal error structure used across all Beast System 3.0 components.

errorId.description: Unique identifier for this error instance (UUID recommended).

component.description: Subsystem where the error originated (governance-kernel, wellbeing-engine, predictive-engine, registry-service, doctrine-compiler, etc.).

code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g., VALIDATION_FAILED, MISSING_FIELD, INVALID_STATE, COMPILATION_ERROR).

traceId.description: Trace identifier for linking this error to related operations.
